follow-up time: At least 6 months after diagnosis (mean follow-up: 40.5 +/- 16.3 months)
outcome: Recovery of left ventricular (LV) systolic function
Composite adverse cardiac events (cardiac death or hospitalization due to worsening heart failure)
cohort: This study included 61 patients with PPCM.
finding: The systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) and left ventricular end-diastolic dimension (LVEDD) were independent predictors of persistent LV systolic dysfunction in patients with PPCM.
